description: This file contains a data structure and a function for mapping keyboard symbols (keysyms) to Unicode code points, specifically for X11 key symbols related to the Kivy framework's window handling on Raspberry Pi 4 64-bit platform.

methods.name: keysym2ucs
methods.description: Converts a keysym to its corresponding Unicode code point using a binary search in a lookup table, with special handling for Latin-1 and 24-bit UCS characters.
